messages:
ash: Heads up — we need a plan for attributing quota/billing when a service account from org-A exchanges tokens to call models on behalf of project-B. Current console shows 'project: unknown' for some exchanges. Proposal: add X-Origin header signed and store hashed origin in telemetry so console can show attribution without exposing raw org/project IDs. Thoughts? https://go/rfc-auth-exchange
kevin: Agree on hashed origin. Also need to decide TTL for ephemeral exchange: do we attribute to origin or to the requesting project?
maria: From console UX side: customers expect to see 'origin' and 'billing project' separately. Can we show 'origin (hashed)' with tooltip 'verified by signature'?
olivia: Security: hashed IDs might still be reversible if attacker has lookup. We should HMAC with a per-account secret (not global) and rotate keys.
sam: SRE: telemetry storage - we can add origin_hash field to traces and billing events. Prefer storing only 1-way HMAC + truncated hex. Example header: `X-Origin-Signature: sha256=abcd1234` and `X-Origin-Context: org:1234;proj:5678;ts:1714512345` (signed).
kevin: Note: avoid adding PII to logs. The signed payload must be validated at ingress and then discarded — only store the hash.
ash: @sam can you sketch the minimal header + verify flow? We should update API gateway and the docs.
sam: Sketch:
```
# client -> gateway
X-Origin-Payload: org=ORG_A;proj=PROJ_X;ts=1714512345
X-Origin-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret_per_org, payload)

# gateway validates, emits telemetry: origin_hash=sha256(HMAC(...))
``` 
Will send PR for gateway and tracer patch.
maria: Console mock: show two columns in route-level billing: Origin (hash) | Billing project. Tooltip for hash: 'redwood verifies origin via signed header; contact support to reveal.' :lock:
olivia: We also need an operator flow for 'support reveal' that requires 2nd approval and an audit log.
ash: :thumbsup: Let's aim for canary on Dedicated first. @kevin can you own rollout policy? @maria own console mock?
kevin: I can take rollout. Plan: feature-flag in gateway, canary 1% for Dedicated orgs, metrics: mismatch rate, failed validates. Rollback if >0.1% validation errors.
deploy-bot: deploy started: origin-hash-feature v2 -> infra/gateway canary (1%) by deploy-bot at 1714512400
ash: Thanks. I'll file a light RFC and link config + PRs in the thread.
